Metadata.title: Mantel Azul
Metadata.description: Full-stack recipe app with Next.js, tRPC, Prisma, and Tailwind.

RecipeForm.uploadDescription: Choose an image to represent your recipe. You can upload an image file from your device.
RecipeForm.sourceLocaleDescription: Language the recipe was originally written in. Changing it regenerates the other languages from the text below.
RecipeForm.title: Title
RecipeForm.timeDescription: Enter the preparation, cooking, and resting times for the recipe. This will help users plan their cooking accordingly.
RecipeForm.nutritionDescription: Enter the nutritional information for the recipe. This will help users understand the nutritional content of the dish.
RecipeForm.createDescription: Fill out the form below to create a new recipe.
RecipeForm.updateDescription: Fill out the form below to update your recipe details.
RecipeForm.ingredientsDescription: Add the ingredients for your recipe. You can specify the quantity and unit for each ingredient to ensure your recipe is accurate and easy to follow.
RecipeForm.editIngredientDescription: Update the details of your ingredient below.
RecipeForm.stepsDescription: Update the steps for your recipe. You can add, edit, reorder, or remove steps as needed to ensure your recipe is clear and easy to follow.
RecipeForm.editStepDescription: Make changes to your step here. Click save when you're done.
RecipeForm.uploadStepImageDescription: Choose an image to represent this step in your recipe. You can upload a new image or select an existing one from your library.
RecipeForm.tagsDescription: Add tags to your recipe to make it easier to find and categorize.

mains.name: Mains
mains.description: Discover our collection of main dishes with a variety of flavors and ingredients to satisfy every palate.

starters.name: Starters
starters.description: Kick off your meal with our delicious starter recipes, featuring a variety of flavors and ingredients to tantalize your taste buds.

desserts.name: Desserts
desserts.description: Indulge in our delectable desserts, from rich chocolate treats to light and fruity delights.

drinks.name: Drinks
drinks.description: Quench your thirst with our refreshing drink recipes, from vibrant cocktails to soothing mocktails.

snacks.name: Snacks
snacks.description: Satisfy your cravings with our delicious snack recipes, perfect for any time of day.

breakfast.name: Breakfast
breakfast.description: Start your day with our delicious breakfast recipes, featuring a variety of options to energize your mornings.

everything.name: Everything
everything.description: Explore our diverse collection of recipes, featuring mains, desserts, drinks, and sides to inspire your culinary adventures.
